body.p: The Search view's Media tab allows you to see all media resources (images, video, audio) defined in particular folders from your project. You can insert references to those media resources or open them in the editor.

dlentry.dd: List of project folders in which to search for media (image, audio, video) resources. Changes made to this list are stored in the user's local browser settings.
Filter the list of resources by typing part of the file name.

List of media resources (images, audio, video). You can use the hovered actions to open each resource or to insert a reference to it. Depending on the resource type the following actions are available:
Images - Insert image reference or figure with image reference. If there is a DITA key defined for the particular image, an image key reference is inserted instead.
Video/Audio - Embed video/audio references. If there is a DITA key defined for the particular resource, the resource is referenced with a key reference.
